text:
olivia: Heads-up: planning sawtooth traffic ramp for the API/runtime/console/router cutover in tonight's quiet window (23:00-01:00). Pin runtime v2.4.1, console 3.2.0, router shim 1.8. Confirming rollback trigger thresholds.

deploy-bot: preflight started: checking pins, schema compat, rolling deploy locks...

simon: I locked the runtime pool to v2.4.1-resilient (sha: a1b2c3d). Router shim pinned to 1.8.0-beta (id: r-1.8.0-b). API remains on canary until ramp completes.

anya: Are we keeping console on 3.1 until +10m? Want to watch logs for header split. Also will metrics be sampled at 100%?

olivia: plan: sawtooth ramp pattern: +5% every 2 minutes for first 20m, then steady 50% for 15m, then full if healthy. We'll sample headers and edge-cases via canary bucket. Metrics: p99 < 220ms, error-rate < 0.5% over 5m window. If either breached, immediate rollback.

jay: Add a CPU pressure check on runtime GPU hosts too. If batch latency > 40ms/step, rollback signal.

marco: I'll monitor token cost delta and set cost guard if > 15% above baseline.

deploy-bot: locks acquired: runtime-pin=a1b2c3d, router-pin=r-1.8.0-b, console-pin tentative=3.2.0-rc. Preflight results: schema-check ok, routing-table diff small, auth header contract verified.

olivia: Ok kick when ready. @simon you're primary for runtime rollback, @anya console, @jay router.

simon: Kicking off canary now. Starting sawtooth0 -> 5%.

deploy-bot: sawtooth step 1: 5% -> 5% traffic to pinned variants. Health checks: ok.

anya: seeing a few header parsing warnings in console logs, but they don't match user-facing errors. Watching.

jay: router reports one zone with 2% increased queueing, but p99 still under threshold.

olivia: hold to observe two more steps. Reminder: rollback criteria = p99>=220ms OR 5m error-rate >=0.5 OR API schema failures.

deploy-bot: sawtooth step 2: 10% -> ok.

simon: batch latency trending +8% but still < 40ms/step.

marco: cost delta +9% so far.

anya: console warnings steady. I'm going to enable verbose metric for header-split for next 10m.

deploy-bot: sawtooth step 3: 15% -> ok. Alerting hooks armed.

simon: stepping to 25% now (two-step bump per plan). If it crosses 40ms I'll cut.

deploy-bot: sawtooth step 4: 25% -> ok.

jay: router queueing normalized after small routing tweak. No further action.

olivia: halfway point. If we make it to 50% steady and no alarms, we'll hold 15m then cutover. Release notes to ship: "runtime v2.4.1: KV cache fix, batching stability; router 1.8: header shim fix; console 3.2: header diagnostics UI."

anya: Noted. I'll prep a quick rollback playbook snippet in case console flip needed:
```
# console rollback
kubectl rollout undo deployment/console --to-revision=3
deploy-bot unlock console
```

simon: runtime rollback: `deploy-bot rollback runtime a1b2c3d` (this will auto-pin previous stable a1b2c3c).

jay: router rollback is manual but quick: unpin shim and route back to r-1.7.

deploy-bot: armed automatic rollback hook: runtime p99 >= 220ms for 3m -> execute runtime rollback. Manual confirmations required for cross-service rollback.

olivia: One more check: ensure analytics trace sampling continues for pinned variants (need 100% traces for 10m). @marco enable.

marco: done.

deploy-bot: sawtooth step 5: 50% steady hold started (15m). Health ok. No rollback triggered.

anya: console logs show header warnings cleared after verbose diag enabled.

simon: runtime GPU mem stable. Batch lat +12% but steady at 34ms.

olivia: After 15m hold we'll either cut to 100% or pause and unpin. If any of us sees regression, shout "rollback now" and call it.

jay: ack. I'm watching router queues and connection resets.

marco: ack cost team on standby.

deploy-bot: hold timer expired. Decision window open.

olivia: Looks green across API/runtime/console/router. Recommend full cut to 100%. Rolling now.

deploy-bot: traffic ramping to 100% per sawtooth plan.

simon: runtime metrics passing; no rollback.

anya: console at 100% healthy.

jay: router stable.

marco: cost delta stabilized at +6%. Acceptable.

deploy-bot: cutover complete. All pins recorded: runtime=a1b2c3d, console=3.2.0-rc, router=r-1.8.0-b. Release notes published: https://redwood/relnotes/1768234567

olivia: Thanks team. Postmortem note: follow up on header parsing warnings and add safe-mode toggles for console. I'll write a short blurb for release channel.

simon: I'll keep runtime watch for next hour.

anya: adding console diagnostics ticket #CR-412.

jay: I'll open a router follow-up for better queue shedding logic.

deploy-bot: locking thread and archiving logs. :lock: :white_check_mark:

olivia: :thumbsup:
